key_insight: ReToken adds a single learnable token that acts like a retrieval query, helping vision-language models focus on the most relevant visual tokens instead of all distractors. This improves retrieval and reasoning under long visual context with little extra training data.
problem_solved: Vision-language models struggle when images or videos contain many distracting tokens, and processing everything is too expensive for GPU memory. The paper addresses how to efficiently retrieve only query-relevant visual information from a large visual cache.
method: Train one learnable embedding as an explicit retrieval target.
Use the token to select a sparse subset of relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache.
Train on a small image-QA dataset and evaluate across image and video benchmarks.
impact: ReToken offers a simple, memory-efficient way to improve long-context visual retrieval without redesigning the whole model. For practitioners, this means better accuracy on cluttered images and videos with minimal added compute and data.
